documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, November 03, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported revenue from operations of INR716.38 crores and profit after tax of INR50.48 crores for Q1 FY27. During the quarter, the company successfully commenced operations at its new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai. The board approved a rights issue of up to INR100 crores to support growth plans and working capital requirements. Management reiterated its full-year guidance targeting 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth, alongside planned operationalization of the Jaipur facility by late 2026. Shanti Gold International Limited reported its financial performance and business updates for Q1 FY27 and FY26 in its investor presentation.

guidance.claim: Shanti Gold targets a top line value growth of 50% to 60% in the current year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

guidance.claim: Volume growth is expected to remain in the 30% to 40% range while value growth is expected in the 50% to 60% range compared to last year.
guidance.quote: So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: Management is maintaining its revenue target guidance of INR3,500 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced continued momentum in its core business during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The quarter also reflected continued momentum in our core business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong demand across both export and local domestic markets following recent exhibitions.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing disposable income drives gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote:
Rising Middle Class
Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: Seasonal demand arises from weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals.
demand_outlook.quote:
Weddings & Festivals
Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Unique Indian designs are attracting global buyers and providing export growth potential.
demand_outlook.quote:
Export Opportunity
Unique Indian designs attracting global buyers; export growth potential

demand_outlook.claim: Branded players like Tanishq, Kalyan, and Malabar are driving consumer trust in the organised shift.
demand_outlook.quote:
Organised Shift
Branded players (Tanishq, Kalyan, Malabar) driving consumer trust

demand_outlook.claim: Monthly jewellery investment schemes improve affordability.
demand_outlook.quote:
Gold Loans Access
Monthly jewellery investment schemes improve affordability

capex_expansion.claim: Operations successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has allocated around INR47 crores of capex for the Jaipur facility, which is expected to be operational around mid-November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur factory is spread across 3 acres of land, with the initial 50,000 square feet representing the first phase of plant development.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects sustainable EBITDA margins to range between 7.5% and 8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin would be around 7.5% to 8%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 7.05%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for the quarter stood at 7.05 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Management targets an operating PAT margin of around 4%.
Inventory gains resulting from an inventory method change contributed roughly 2% to 2.5% to margins.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the existing Mumbai facility is currently at 75%.
Designer jewellery accounts for 75% of revenue while plain gold jewellery represents 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: 75% of the revenue is from our designer jewellery and 25% from plain gold jewellery.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity is approximately 6,700 kg per annum across Andheri and Marol post commissioning.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: Total capacity on completion is 7,900 kg per annum including the upcoming Jaipur facility.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 equity shares aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company currently has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.50 and plans to keep it below 1x.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: Funds raised from the rights issue will be deployed into gold inventory and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold prices remained in a narrow range during the current year, with subdued demand in May and June.
risks_headwinds.quote: Going ahead in this current year, actually, it has remained in a narrow band of say, around 142 to 150 range, right? And the May and June was quite subdued.

risks_headwinds.claim: High volatility in gold prices previously led the company to temporarily step back from Gold Metal Loans.
risks_headwinds.quote: So earlier also we used to do GML and all, but due to the high volatility, we went on -- we came out from GML.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur facility is slated to become operational around mid-November or December.
management_commitments.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve top line revenue of around INR3,500 crores for the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth this year.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
